findings.title: Defer import execution until an app is requested
findings.body: Every import() in this object executes as soon as the app-store index is loaded, so accessing a single calendar or payment provider still starts loading and evaluating all app packages. This splits the modules into chunks but does not defer unused apps, retaining the all-app initialization cost on cold starts. Store loader functions instead and invoke only the selected loader at the call sites. This also allows import failures to be handled by the requesting caller rather than leaving rejected promises for unused apps unobserved.
